method: Read primary .m-productpage-price only. 'Добавить в корзину' in this block = in stock; 'Ожидаем поступление' inside .m-productpage-price__status with no buy button = out of stock. Ignore bottom bar and recommendation elements.
policy: Out-of-stock wines stay in source data and are hidden in site UI; unknown inventory remains visible. Independently published Vivino/critic data still display; WineStyle-reported scores do not display.
